mechanism: Hydrocodone causes CNS depression that may potentiate levodopa's neurological effects and increase risk of sedation, dizziness, and impaired motor coordination; opioids may also reduce GI motility affecting levodopa absorption.
action: Monitor patients closely for excessive sedation, dizziness, and motor impairment; consider dose adjustment of hydrocodone if CNS depression is problematic; educate patients to avoid driving and hazardous activities.
